decisions.reason: Its premium hand-knotted carpet remains consistent with the firm's craftsmanship identity, and without visible evidence of a performance shortfall below aspiration levels management would likely keep it despite niche-demand risk.
After earlier pruning of other carpets, this close-to-core low-pile carpet faces less internal overlap, so unless it clearly underperforms relative to aspirations it is more likely to stay.
The corner bench fits the established furniture and project business well, so it likely meets aspiration levels sufficiently and does not justify reallocating resources away from it.

As a multi-model swivel shell chair line close to the core offer, it provides broad application and learning value, making continuation the more likely decision while industry conditions remain supportive.
